answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 7342 Country: India Title: My name is ashfaque mirza and my syster name is Tarannum mirza,so pls guide me, Her name "Tarannum" is permissible or not and also guide me about shirin and shahin, it is also permissible or not. Question: Assalamo-alaikum, My name is ashfaque mirza and my syster name is Tarannum mirza,so pls guide me, Her name "Tarannum" is permissible or not and also guide me about shirin and shahin, it is also permissible or not. Answer ID: 7342 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 855/855=M/1429) Trannum means: to sing, to make melodious sound. It is better to choose a better name. Shirin means: sweet, soft, pleasant. Shahin is a predatory white bird. The last two names are alright. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
